sensor_governance.statement: Four Landsat 8 observations (2021, 2022, 2024, 2025) and one Landsat 9 observation in 2023. Explicit platform identity preserved across all layers. Zero unsupported cross-sensor calibration factors applied.

intended_analytic_uses: Annual comparative anomaly analysis (relative to 5-year mean)
explicit_prohibitions: Do NOT describe these five annual pre-monsoon snapshots as a long-term climate trend.
Do NOT infer causal climate change from this dataset.

qa_logic.standard: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 QA_PIXEL & QA_RADSAT Specifications

qa_pixel_bit_definitions.bit_4: Cloud Shadow (1 = high confidence cloud shadow)
qa_pixel_bit_definitions.bit_6: Clear (1 = clear land or water, no cloud/shadow/cirrus)

qa_radsat_saturation_mask.description: Bitmask selecting saturation in visible, NIR, SWIR, and thermal bands

qa_logic.valid_clear_definition: A pixel is valid clear iff it is non-fill, not cloud, not cloud shadow, not dilated cloud, not cirrus, and not radiometrically saturated.
